newsitem.title: USA: United Industrial venture sees contract.
newsitem.headline: United Industrial venture sees contract.

text.p: United Industrial Corp said Electric Transit Inc, its joint venture with Czech manufacturer SKODA SA, will be recommended for the award of a contract to produce 250 electric trolley coaches for the city and county of San Francisco.
The contract is valued at $170 million and about $50 million of that would go to United International's defense contractor subsidiary AAI.
"Our defense contractor subsidiary, AAI, performed very well during the quarter," United International chief executive Richard Erkeneff said.
"We continue to be successful in taking advantage of AAI's superior technological capabilities to expand our presence in the transportation marketplace," he added.
